title: Ground-truth validation of the ‘earbuds method’ for measuring acoustic nasalance
why_promising: Primary non-singing American English production. The study reports manually corrected word- and phone-level WebMAUS TextGrid boundaries, manual checks after amplitude normalization, co-registered oral/nasal audio from a commercial nasometer plus flat and silicone earbuds, time-varying nasalance/intensity measures, F0-based voiced labels, and public data/R code at OSF. It includes 36 read-text productions and 28,524 observations with the nasometer in place (15,667 voiced).
open_question: Enumerate the OSF file tree and verify which public files contain the corrected TextGrids, interval labels, raw/time-varying nasalance or intensity trajectories, F0 tracks, device/placement/repetition/text identifiers, and licensing. Promote only after source files and redistribution terms are inspected; preserve all sampled trajectory points rather than only summary correlations.
